request: Ara, Rehber and Oynatıcı have their own BackHandlers whose enabled flag follows a route change only on the next applied frame; a Back in that gap reached the old screen (e.g. a quick second Back after Ara's menu -> Home ran model.home() again and was lost instead of asking). Apply the PilotApp principle (decide by the model's route when Back arrives) to these handlers without changing behaviour on their own route.
decision: When the model's route is no longer the screen's own, the screen hands Back to PilotApp's route-level rule (routeBack): HOME -> exit question, any other route -> model.back(). The new screen's focus-dependent first step (Home content -> side menu, Guide grid -> menu, Player controls -> hide) does not exist yet in that gap, so the gap follows the rule PilotApp already used for LOADING/LIBRARY/DETAIL -> HOME. No new product decision.
changes: ui/PilotApp.kt: routeBack = { HOME -> exitAsk = true, else model.back() }; the general BackHandler calls it and passes it to SearchScreen, GuideScreen and PlayerScreen.

ui/SearchScreen.kt, ui/GuideScreen.kt, ui/PlayerScreen.kt: new `back` parameter; each BackHandler first checks model.state.value.route and calls back() when it is not SEARCH / GUIDE / PLAYER. (The parameter and the three checks were added by the parallel 0.14.37 session so its build compiled; same design, kept as is.)

ui/HomeScreen.kt: HomeBackToMenu (added in 0.14.36, the same gap: after Home -> Library the Back focused Home's menu and was lost) calls model.back() when the model has left Home; on Home it still opens the side menu. The existing backFollowsTheModelRouteBeforeTheScreenCatchesUp failed on this before.
